mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, sd.D_Name as dName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from OA_WorkOrder mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Department sd on sd.D_Id = mn.D_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Wo_Id where mn.Wo_Id = #{woId}
